verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions HIPAA compliance, a BAA, a SOC 2 attestation, or data-residency/region options. The closest item is per-agent data retention with automatic deletion 'for compliance' (retell-docs-15, retell-docs-27). That is a data-lifecycle control, not any of the certifications or residency choices the story asks for, so it is not credited here.
